speaker: alice
text: Let's kick off with some fantastic environmental news from our Kiwi neighbours. New Zealand's kakapo population just smashed all records with over 100 chicks hatching this season.

speaker: charlie
text: That's massive! These little legends are one of the world's rarest birds with just 235 adults left. Vets even did CPR on struggling chicks to help them through - talk about dedication.

speaker: alice
text: And speaking of green wins, Europe just hit a major milestone. For the first time ever, wind and solar power generated more electricity than fossil fuels across the EU in 2025 - 30% versus 29%.
